name: FrugalNeRF
definition: A few-shot NeRF framework that leverages weight-sharing voxels across multiple scales to efficiently represent scene details and uses a cross-scale geometric adaptation scheme to select pseudo ground truth depth based on reprojection errors, enabling fast convergence without learned priors.
summary: FrugalNeRF is a few-shot NeRF framework that synthesizes novel views from extremely sparse inputs using weight-sharing voxels and reprojection-based pseudo-ground truth, avoiding external priors.
